text: * HAVE RECEIVED FOLLOWING TELEX FROM AL BABTAIN IN REFERENCE TO PM
* REFYRTLX 3779 OF 28TH SEPT 85 RE VISAS FOR P.M. PERSONNEL TO VISIT
* KUWAIT. WE CONTACTED OUR FOREIGN MINISTRY AND THEY SAY IT IS NOT
* REGULAR. UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES WE PREFER TO MAKE VISAS IN KUWAIT.
* SO YU PLS ARRANGE TO SEND US THROUGH DHL PHOTOSTAT COPIES OF THEIR
* PLEASE NOTE THAT I AM TRAVELLING TO KUWAIT TODAY, AND WILL TAKE
* COPIES OF PASSPORTS AND PHOTOGRAPHS OF MESSRS. BODER, KELLY, PIERCE,
* I DO NOT HAVE PASSPORT DETAILS AND PHOTOGRAPH OF MR. LOWMAN. I
* BELIEVE THESE WILL BE COURIERED TO US, AND ON RECEIPT THESE WILL BE
* COURIERED TO KUWAIT FOR VISA APPLICATION.
* I WILL REQUEST THAT VISA APPLICATIONS FOR YOURSELF AND THE
* ABOVE-MENTIONED PEOPLE BE SUBMITTED TOMORROW MORNING TO THE RELATIVE
* IT NORMALLY TAKES ABOUT 7 DAYS TO OBTAIN VISAS IN KUWAIT, AND THUS I
* WILL ASK THEM TO PUT THESE THROUGH AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.
